title: The Art of Defending: A Systematic Evaluation and Analysis of LLM Defense Strategies on Safety and Over-Defensiveness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to unsafe prompts from the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset and other safety datasets, categorizing them under 'Discrimination, Exclusion, Toxicity, Hateful, Offensive' risks. For BBQ questions specifically, a heuristic evaluation is used to check the presence of the ground truth in the response to determine if social biases against protected classes manifest in the model outputs.
